title: EmuCore X - PS2 Emulator Android | Beginner Guide & Game Test
summary: An 18-minute beginner-oriented EmuCoreX recording with a silent visual guide, touch-button editing and four separate PS2 gameplay samples.

blocks.text: Kombuzuka Rise divides the video into a setup guide through 7:22, followed by four game tests. The on-screen demonstration is more important than the sparse narration: it shows where to complete onboarding, launch a title and return to configuration, then revisits touch controls at 9:54 to edit and add buttons during the longer test sequence.

Using several games makes this a better interface-and-launch survey than a single showcase, but the video does not document a repeatable hardware and settings table. It should answer “what does the workflow look like?” rather than “what frame rate will my phone deliver?” Viewers comparing performance still need the same game revision, renderer, internal resolution and device details.
